## Project Overview
This is a Campus Chatbot Assistant for Usha Rama College of Engineering and Technology (URCET). The project is built using React with TypeScript and Vite as the build tool.

## Project Goals
- Create a user-friendly chatbot interface for students and staff
- Handle queries about academics, events, departments, and campus facilities
- Provide quick access to information without backend dependencies
- Use modern React patterns and TypeScript best practices

## Development Guidelines
- Use functional components with React hooks
- Implement TypeScript interfaces for all data structures
- Create responsive design that works on mobile and desktop
- Use modern CSS (Grid, Flexbox) for layouts
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Follow React best practices for component composition
- Use semantic HTML for accessibility

## Chatbot Features to Implement
- Interactive chat interface
- Pre-defined responses for common queries
- Categories: Academics, Events, Departments, Facilities
- Search functionality within responses
- Quick action buttons for common queries
- Responsive design for mobile devices

## UI/UX Requirements
- Modern and clean interface
- URCET branding colors and styling
- Intuitive navigation
- Fast loading and smooth animations
- Accessibility considerations
